visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains only one lightly wobbly oval ball contour centered low enough to leave room for the chain. Its closed outline gives a beginner a fixed metal shell and clear scale.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I compared all five saved square crops in order. The ball edge, left hinge, right clasp, six separate upper holes, top ring, three linked ovals and open hook keep their positions. No temporary guides appear. The last image shades the established shell and adds only a ground shadow.

transitions.observed_addition: The curved double seam crosses the lower third of the same ball; a tiny round hinge lands on its left edge and a rectangular clasp on its right edge.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved second crop follows the instruction to fit the two halves and attach hardware at the seam ends.

transitions.observed_addition: Six small dark holes appear above the seam in two staggered rows of three; the ball, seam, hinge and clasp stay visible.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved third crop matches the instruction to space six upper-shell perforations.

transitions.observed_addition: One ring grows from the ball top; three linked narrow ovals arc to the upper right and meet one open hook. All six holes and seam hardware remain.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved fourth crop matches the top-ring, three-link and free-hook instruction.

transitions.observed_addition: Soft graphite darkens the right and lower shell, the existing seam and chain; a pale upper-left highlight and soft shadow under the ball give volume without new structure.
transitions.instruction_match: The finished crop matches the shading and ground-shadow instruction; no new contour is required.
